export_rights.summary: Microsoft's Trust Center states 'You own your data' and that Microsoft uses customer data only to provide the agreed services. After a subscription ends, data remains extractable through a documented wind-down: full access during a 30-day Expired stage, admin-only access during a 90-day Disabled stage, then deletion — 'no later than 180 days after cancellation'.
export_rights.post_termination_window: 30 days Expired (all users retain access) + 90 days Disabled (admins only can still access and export); Trust Center describes a 90-day limited-function account after termination, after which data including cached/backup copies is deleted within an additional 90 days. Data is deleted no later than 180 days after cancellation.

routes.how: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: create a case/search scoped to mailboxes, Teams, SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts and document libraries; Searches tab > select completed search > Export; monitor in Process manager and download from the Exports tab (per-file Download button, plus summary reports).
requires: eDiscovery Manager or eDiscovery Administrator role group (assigned in Purview portal under Settings > Roles and Scopes > Role groups); Global/Compliance Administrators cannot access eDiscovery unless explicitly added
gotchas: Partially indexed (unindexed) items are excluded unless you pick the 'indexed plus partially indexed' or 'partially indexed only' export option
SharePoint/OneDrive document versions default to latest; exporting recent 10/100 or all versions is an explicit option
Teams/Viva Engage contextual messages capture at most 12 hours of related conversation
Cloud attachments from linked repositories are collected only if the option is selected

routes.how: Microsoft Graph REST API (https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0), OAuth 2.0 via Entra ID app registration with delegated or application permissions. Examples: GET /users/{id}/chats/getAllMessages for all of a user's chat messages (filterable by date range); GET /drives/{drive-id}/items/{item-id}/content for file content.
requires: Entra ID app registration; admin consent for application permissions; Teams export APIs (getAllMessages family) required a metered-API billing configuration before August 25, 2025 — since then they are no longer metered
routes.rate_limits: Global limit 130,000 requests per 10 seconds across all services; Outlook service limits are 10,000 API requests per 10-minute period, 4 concurrent requests, and 150 MB upload per 5 minutes (v1.0 and beta); other workloads have their own service-specific limits.
gotchas: driveItem /content returns 302 with a preauthenticated download URL that can expire within minutes — use it immediately
Per-workload throttling varies and Microsoft documents the limits as subject to change

routes.how: Microsoft Graph Data Connect: bulk, dataset-level extraction of Microsoft 365 data (basic/cleaned/curated datasets) delivered to an Azure Storage resource and consumable via Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Azure Data Factory; tenant-admin consent requests are approved in the Microsoft 365 admin center or PowerShell.
requires: tenant admin consent to data requests
gotchas: Designed for analytics at scale (petabytes), not ad-hoc export; requires standing Azure infrastructure

routes.how: Microsoft Entra admin center: Users > All users > Download users — produces a CSV of user profile properties (27 core attributes such as userPrincipalName, displayName, mail, jobTitle; a preview adds 27 more including Assigned licenses, Employee ID, Last interactive sign-in date).
requires: Both admin and standard users can download user lists per the doc
gotchas: The download reflects any filters applied to the current view — clear filters to get the full directory

routes.how: Microsoft 365 admin center > Reports > Usage; open a service's detail report via 'View more'; export the report to Excel, to Power BI, or pull the same data via the Microsoft Graph reports API. Reports cover the last 7, 30, 90, and 180 days.
requires: Global Administrator, Exchange Administrator, Reports Reader, or Usage Summary Reports Reader role
gotchas: Report data lands within 24-72 hours, sometimes several days — not real-time

routes.how: Search-UnifiedAuditLog in Exchange Online PowerShell (StartDate/EndDate required) searches the unified audit log across Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID, Teams, Power BI and other services; pipe to CSV. For programmatic/ongoing download Microsoft recommends the Office 365 Management Activity API instead.
requires: Exchange Online PowerShell with appropriate audit permissions
routes.rate_limits: Default 100 records; ResultSize max 5,000; SessionCommand ReturnLargeSet returns up to 50,000 results (unsorted, paginated); ReturnNextPreviewPage max 5,000 sorted records.
gotchas: Retention limits what is exportable: the default Audit (Standard→E5 default policy) retains Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Entra audit records for one year, but only 90 days for non-E5 users and guests; retention beyond 90 days needs E5 or an E5 Compliance / eDiscovery and Audit add-on; up to 10 years needs the 10-year audit retention add-on; max 50 audit retention policies
Cmdlet returns no results in the 21Vianet (China) environment

routes.how: Per-file bulk download via Graph: GET /drives/{drive-id}/items/{item-id}/content (also /me/drive/... and /users/{userId}/drive/...) returns 302 to a preauthenticated download URL; supports Range headers for partial downloads. Minimum permission Files.Read; script over drive item enumerations for bulk pulls.
requires: Entra ID app or delegated token with Files.Read (minimum)
gotchas: Preauthenticated download URLs expire within minutes
Browser (CORS) contexts must use the @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl property rather than calling /content directly

routes.how: Exchange Online PowerShell: $file = Export-TransportRuleCollection; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes('C:\path\Rules.xml', $file.FileData). Cloud service supports -Format RuleCollectionXML, InternalXML, or DlpMigrationRuleCollection. Output is a re-importable XML rule collection.
requires: Exchange Online PowerShell with transport-rules permissions
gotchas: Post-2013 export format is not importable into Exchange Server 2010

preservation_notes.attachments: Mailbox content including messages exports via Purview eDiscovery as PST/MSG, with an explicit option to collect cloud attachments from linked repositories; OneDrive/SharePoint files bulk-extract via Graph driveItem /content downloads. No single-click tenant-wide file dump outside eDiscovery/Graph appears in the consulted docs.
preservation_notes.audit_log: Export via Search-UnifiedAuditLog (ResultSize max 5,000; up to 50,000 with SessionCommand ReturnLargeSet) or the Management Activity API. Documented retention: default policy keeps Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Entra audit records 1 year (E5); 90 days for non-E5 users; Audit Premium add-on extends to 10 years.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Exchange transport rules export as a restorable XML collection via Export-TransportRuleCollection. The consulted docs document no whole-tenant configuration export; most other configuration (Entra, SharePoint, Teams policies) is readable via Graph/PowerShell but was not confirmed as a packaged restorable artifact.

notes: learn.microsoft.com, docs.microsoft.com, and support.microsoft.com were blocked by this environment's egress proxy, so docs were consulted via Microsoft's own public documentation source repositories on GitHub (MicrosoftDocs/* and microsoftgraph/*, which generate learn.microsoft.com) plus microsoft.com pages; cited raw.githubusercontent.com URLs are the exact files read. Honest unknowns: (1) the DPA document text itself was not retrievable (only its version-listing page), so contractual export language beyond the Trust Center summary is unconfirmed; (2) no eDiscovery export size caps or the classic Content Search 2-GB/PST-split behavior could be confirmed from reachable docs and are therefore omitted; (3) the end-user Outlook 'export to PST' flow lives on support.microsoft.com (blocked) and is omitted; (4) SharePoint/OneDrive and Teams per-workload Graph throttling numbers beyond the global 130,000 req/10s and Outlook figures were in include files not individually fetched; (5) whether the Entra user CSV download has a row cap is not stated in the consulted doc. eDiscovery role requirement is notable: Global Admin alone cannot run the tenant-wide content export.
